pages.title: American Paint
pages.text: Bold patchwork coats are the signature. Same all-purpose build as the Quarter Horse, with a dramatic **white field** pattern.

pages.title: Trail Blazer
pages.text:
Ride with a **map in hand** and an American Paint fills it in over **twice the usual distance** from the path you are actually on.

One ride across unexplored country charts four times the area, which makes this the breed to be on when the job is finding out what is out there.
